data.name: Best Western Suites Le Jardin Caldas Novas
data.address: Rue Machado De Assis, Number 555, No. 555, Caldas Novas - GO, 75690-000, Brazil
data.description:
In downtown Caldas Novas, this modern hotel is 3 km from both diRoma Acqua Park and Jardim Japones garden.
Simple rooms have free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and minifridges, as well as desks. Upgraded quarters add coffeemakers and/or pull-out sofas.
Freebies include parking and hot breakfast, which is served in a bright restaurant. Amenities consist of indoor and outdoor pools, a hot tub and a kids' pool, as well as a fitness room, a sauna and a tennis court. There’s also a business center, a conference center and a cocktail lounge.
